notes: 18 practical phrases for Rohingya refugees entering Canada, covering pharmacy/medical, transportation, groceries, and rules/regulations.
Phrases marked 'source_attested' are directly taken from the CLEAR Global Gamayun kit5k parallel corpus (professionally translated by CLEAR Global translators).
Phrases marked 'ai_draft' are composed from attested vocabulary patterns found in the corpus but are not directly attested as complete sentences.
All entries require native-speaker review before use as gold evaluation data.
Corpus source: Gamayun Language Data Kits — Rohingya (5k), CC BY 4.0, CLEAR Global.
Do not treat AI-drafted entries as validated training or evaluation gold data before native-speaker review.
